blocks.prompt: 14. If \(x = a\sec t\) and \(y = b\tan t\), show that \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{-b^2x}{a^2y}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh 'show that' wala sawal hai, yani jawab pehle se likha hua hai aur humein usay saabit karna hai.
Diya kya hai? \(x = a\sec t\), \(y = b\tan t\): parametric equations. Saabit kya karna hai? \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{-b^2x}{a^2y}\).
Rule kaunsa? \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\), phir \(\sec t = \frac{x}{a}\) aur \(\tan t = \frac{y}{b}\) rakh kar \(t\) ko khatam karna.
Plan: derivatives, divide, substitute, aur aakhir mein imaandari se dekhna ke hamara jawab diye gaye jawab se milta hai ya nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x = a\sec t\), \(y = b\tan t\).
Saabit karna: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{-b^2x}{a^2y}\) (jaisa kitab mein chhapa hai).
Tareeqa: parametric differentiation, phir \(\sec t\) aur \(\tan t\) ko \(x\) aur \(y\) se badalna, kyunke jawab \(x, y\) mein maanga gaya hai.

\(t\) ke respect se derivatives
\[\dfrac{dx}{dt} = a\sec t\tan t\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dt} = b\sec^2 t\]
Kyun: \(a\) aur \(b\) constants hain, bahar rehte hain. \((\sec t)' = \sec t\tan t\) aur \((\tan t)' = \sec^2 t\).

Divide karein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{b\sec^2 t}{a\sec t\tan t} = \dfrac{b\sec t}{a\tan t}\]
Kyun: parametric formula; upar \(\sec^2 t\) aur neeche \(\sec t\), to ek \(\sec t\) cancel ho gaya.

\(x\) aur \(y\) mein likhein
\[\sec t = \dfrac{x}{a},\quad \tan t = \dfrac{y}{b}\]
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{b \cdot \frac{x}{a}}{a \cdot \frac{y}{b}} = \dfrac{b^2x}{a^2y}\]
Kyun: diye gaye equations ko \(a\) aur \(b\) se divide kiya to \(\sec t\) aur \(\tan t\) mil gaye. Phir fraction ke fraction ko seedha kiya: \(\frac{bx}{a}\cdot\frac{b}{ay} = \frac{b^2x}{a^2y}\). Is mein kahin bhi minus sign paida nahi hua.

Tasdeeq: \(t\) ko khatam kar ke
\[\sec^2 t - \tan^2 t = 1 \Rightarrow \dfrac{x^2}{a^2} - \dfrac{y^2}{b^2} = 1\]
\[\dfrac{2x}{a^2} - \dfrac{2y}{b^2}\dfrac{dy}{dx} = 0 \Rightarrow \dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{b^2x}{a^2y}\]
Kyun: identity \(\sec^2 t - \tan^2 t = 1\) se curve ki asal shakal mili: yeh hyperbola hai. Is ko implicit differentiation se differentiate kiya to phir wohi plus wala jawab aaya. Do alag raston se ek hi natija.

Diye gaye jawab se muqabla
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = +\dfrac{b^2x}{a^2y} \neq \dfrac{-b^2x}{a^2y}\]
Kyun: kitab ka diya hua jawab sign mein ghalat hai, is liye usay saabit karna mumkin hi nahi. Neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' dekhiye.
Dhyan dein: 'show that' sawal mein jawab zabardasti milane ke liye sign mat badliye. Agar do tareeqon se ek hi jawab aaye to apne kaam par bharosa kijiye.
blocks.final_answer: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{b^2x}{a^2y}\). Kitab ka \(\frac{-b^2x}{a^2y}\) sign mein ghalat hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{-b^2x}{a^2y}\) saabit karo. Lekin \(x = a\sec t\), \(y = b\tan t\) ke liye sahi natija \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{b^2x}{a^2y}\) hai (plus sign ke saath), jaisa upar dono tareeqon se saabit hua. Minus sign ellipse \(x = a\cos t\), \(y = b\sin t\) ka hota hai, jahan \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -\frac{b\cos t}{a\sin t} = -\frac{b^2x}{a^2y}\) banta hai. Shayad kitab ne yeh do sawal aapas mein mila diye.
